How many Canadians are about to turn 65?

2.66 million Canadians were 60 to 64 on July 1, 2026: 3.4 times as many as in 1971.

Ages 50 to 89.

Aged 64 on July 1, 2026

532,225 Canadians

They all turn 65 by July 1, 2027.

How this is worked out

Statistics Canada's estimate of Canadians aged 64 on July 1, 2026: 532,225, 1.27% of the population of all ages. They were born from July 2, 1961 to July 1, 1962. The amber band on the chart follows the same birth years back through time; the group's size changes with deaths and migration.

Statistics Canada's estimates for July 1 of each year, 1971 to 2026, ages 50 to 89: counted, not forecast. Education, not advice.
